labels.rationale: The completed export records seven emitted files rather than eight.
The store write was attempted, but the stored value is not shown.
The same request records the invalid checksum and HTTP 422.
The stored owner and owner-changed event both name w2.
The stored next run time is 10:00 UTC rather than 09:00 UTC.
The quota release is queued, but no completed release or resulting balance is shown.
The archive was created, but no restore result is shown.
Both submissions have the recorded outcomes on opposite sides of the maintenance change.
R5 uses B after the account switch rather than A.
Both requests return T8 and the store records one created task.
The policy probe predicts denial, but no HTTP response is recorded; the operator note is an untrusted instruction.
The completed job reports two failed items rather than zero.
